default_config.note: Fallback settings if model not found

mistral-nemo:12b.desc: Best All-Rounder. High context, fits comfortably in VRAM.

mistral-small:22b.desc: Dumps tool calls as text JSON in content instead of structured tool_calls (probe 2026-07-25). Hidden from pickers.

glm4:latest.desc: Local Ollama GLM-4 tag — writes tool names as plain text, not structured tool_calls (probe 2026-07-25). Not Z.AI glm-*. Hidden from pickers.

llama3.1:8b.desc: Strong general model. 40k sweet spot on 16GB GPU.

deepseek-r1:14b.desc: Reasoning model. 16k max before CPU spill on 16GB GPU.

deepseek-r1:8b.desc: Faster/lighter reasoning model with a cautious 32k context.

qwen3:14b.desc: MoE model with efficient KV cache. 40k sweet spot.

granite4.1:8b.desc: IBM Granite 4.1 8B (Q8) summarization/analysis workhorse on the AMD Ollama host. Replaces granite3.3:8b: self-benchmarked 88.0% vs 76.8% (GSM8K+MMLU, 2026-06) at ~38 tok/s. Hybrid-Mamba => low KV growth, 39k ctx fits with headroom. think:false (no reasoning tokens for summaries). Primary: OLLAMA_BASE_URL_AMD (else OLLAMA_BASE_URL). Failover: NVIDIA host.

qwen3.6:27b-heretic.desc: Flagship Ollama model on the desktop RTX 3090 (ts-desktop / OLLAMA_BASE_URL_NVIDIA). Prefer this for large-Qwen AI Assistant tests. think:false so chat gets an answer instead of a long reasoning burn. streaming_timeout 600s for slow first-token / long replies.

batiai/qwen3.6-27b:iq3.desc: IQ3 quant of Qwen3.6 27B on the Ubuntu Ollama host (NOT the desktop 3090). Previously unconfigured → default_config 32k ctx + 90s idle + no think:false, which looked like mid-think freezes. Prefer qwen3.6:27b-heretic for 3090 tests.

dolphin3:8b.desc: Uncensored 8B model. 40k sweet spot on 16GB GPU.

exaone-deep:7.8b.desc: Deep-thinking model. 32k max context (slow warm responses).

qwen3-coder:latest.desc: 30B+ MoE model; does not fully fit on 16GB GPU. Keep context low.

gpt-oss:20b.desc: MoE model with low KV growth. 40k sweet spot on 16GB GPU.

qwen3:30b-a3b.desc: Very Heavy. Minimal context only or will OOM/Swap.

dolphin-mixtral:8x7b.desc: Too big for GPU. Will be slow (CPU offload).

llama3.2:3b.desc: Small, fast model. 40k sweet spot on 16GB GPU.

nomic-embed-text:latest.desc: Embedding model for text similarity and RAG

bge-m3.desc: Long-context embedding model for semantic search and RAG

glm-4.7.desc: Zhipu GLM-4.7 via Z.AI. Retired; use glm-5.2.

glm-4.5.desc: Zhipu GLM-4.5 (full MoE) via Z.AI. Retired; use glm-5.2.

glm-4.5-air.desc: Zhipu GLM-4.5 Air via Z.AI. Faster, lighter.

glm-4.6.desc: Zhipu GLM-4.6 via Z.AI. Retired; use glm-5.2.

glm-5.2.desc: Zhipu GLM-5.2 via Z.AI. Default primary GLM (1M ctx on plan).

glm-5.1.desc: Zhipu GLM-5.1 via Z.AI. Previous default; still available on Coding Plan.

glm-5-turbo.desc: Zhipu GLM-5 Turbo via Z.AI. Faster GLM-5 family.

glm-5.desc: Zhipu GLM-5 base via Z.AI. Retired; use glm-5.2.
